scope: Read-only SOURCE2 semantic review; no implementation, schema edits, Git, Vault or external runtime actions.

concrete_blockers.finding: A source-version association cannot embed the future receipt hash of the same transaction. Capture has no receipt/head; source registration must first be operator-applied and audited, then association publication may reference that prior receipt.
concrete_blockers.required_rule: First registered association requires an existing audited source-ledger registration receipt {path,sha256}; no self-reference or capture-result-as-receipt substitution.

concrete_blockers.finding: source_id is only file locator+content SHA identity. Version identity and immutable observation association need separate keys.
concrete_blockers.required_rule: source_version_id reuse key is domain-separated JCS({paper_id,version_descriptor,markdown_sha256}); declared same label+different bytes conflicts; unknown keys include markdown SHA; association/provenance bytes are immutable and never overwritten.

concrete_blockers.finding: Research proposals and a display-head cache cannot select the current source. Existing v1 transaction policy/catalog do not define a source-head registry.
concrete_blockers.required_rule: Engine validates a complete nonforking append-only decision chain and materialized head in a successor namespace/transaction; imports never auto-select and rollback is a new decision.

concrete_blockers.finding: v1 assessment_history/ledger_locator/identity only accept PDF/code and v1 fingerprints have no profile field.
concrete_blockers.required_rule: v2 event/profile schema and fingerprint are explicit; one v1-to-v2 boundary event to provisional preserves the prior immutable v1 head/claim snapshot; no second independently authoritative assessment genesis and no v2 input to v1 validators.

concrete_blockers.finding: establish_canonical_paper_id rejects a higher-priority arXiv ID when existing paper_id is sha256.
concrete_blockers.required_rule: Preserve existing paper/claim IDs and add a separately validated immutable alias binding only after same-source proof; refuse a second paper record or contradictory alias binding. Keep v1 function unchanged.

resolved_semantics.same_version_same_bytes_different_proven: Reuse stable source_version_id/content association only when paper/version/Markdown bytes match; do not overwrite its observation. Preserve differing original_pdf_sha256/page metadata/observation as immutable provenance-variant record or return explicit PROVENANCE_VARIANT requiring follow-up. Never treat original_pdf_sha256 as source/version identity.
resolved_semantics.v1_to_v2_boundary: Use one explicit v1-to-v2 boundary event to provisional that references prior v1 head/claim snapshot; preserve old v1 event bytes and do not create an independent authoritative second history.
resolved_semantics.first_association: Requires prior audited source registration receipt; proposal may remain unregistered and must not claim current/receipt-backed.

unresolved_freeze_questions: Choose the exact immutable provenance-variant schema/path and whether a variant is accepted as a reusable association or only recorded as a refusal requiring explicit operator follow-up.
Freeze exact v2 event/profile IDs and the boundary event fields that reference the v1 head/claim snapshot.
Freeze engine-owned namespace/path and transaction successor for display decisions/head and alias bindings; do not imply current v1 registry support.
Freeze source-registration receipt reference shape and prior-receipt read preconditions in the first association publication.
excluded_until_follow_on_packets: source-capture modules and frozen v1 observation schemas
paper-record.v2 implementation and real Vault or operator apply
